issues.title: Page is in the sitemap but set to noindex
issues.fix: Remove it from the sitemap or remove the noindex.

issues.title: Title shorter than 30 characters
issues.why: Short titles under-use the main ranking signal.
issues.fix: Expand with the page topic and brand.

issues.title: Images without alt attribute
issues.why: Alt text feeds image search and accessibility.
issues.fix: Add descriptive alt text (alt="" for pure decoration).

issues.title: Fewer than 200 words
issues.why: Thin pages rarely rank for competitive terms.
issues.fix: Add useful, unique content or consolidate the page.

issues.title: Page has no internal links pointing to it
issues.why: Crawlers and visitors cannot find it by clicking.
issues.fix: Link to it from relevant pages.

issues.title: Missing meta description
issues.why: Google writes its own snippet, often a worse one.

issues.title: Duplicate meta description
issues.fix: Write a unique description per page.

issues.title: HTML document over 500 KB
issues.why: Heavy HTML slows parsing on phones.
issues.fix: Trim inline scripts and data from the document.

issues.title: Slow server response (over 800 ms)
issues.why: A slow first byte delays everything else.
issues.fix: Cache the page, tune the backend or use a CDN.

issues.title: Missing Open Graph tags
issues.why: Shared links will look plain on Facebook, LinkedIn and Slack.

issues.title: Missing Twitter card
issues.why: Shared links on X will look plain.

issues.title: Meta description shorter than 70 characters
issues.why: A short snippet misses a chance to sell the click.

issues.title: Only one internal link points to this page
issues.why: Little internal authority flows to it.
